shortDescription: Apply/Remove ACL configuration on VLANs for AOS-CX.

options.name: acl_direction
options.description: Direction for which the ACL is to be applied or removed.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: Name of the ACL being applied or removed from the VLAN.

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Type of ACL being applied or removed from the VLAN.

options.name: acl_vlan_list
options.description: List of VLANs for which the ACL is to be applied or removed.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete the ACL configuration from the VLANs.
